rods.name: Bamboo Stick
rods.desc: A stick with string. Honest work.

rods.name: Fiberglass Rod
rods.desc: Faster reel, softer tip. Forgiving on the line.

rods.name: Carbon Caster
rods.desc: Light, stiff, and a little bit showy.

rods.name: Moonwhisper Rod
rods.desc: Hums faintly. Catches things that should not be catchable.

lines.name: Old Line
lines.desc: Six pound test and a lot of hope.

lines.name: Braided Line
lines.desc: Takes a beating without complaining. Much.

lines.name: Ghost Line
lines.desc: Barely visible, absurdly strong. Slight air of smugness.

lures.name: Silver Spoon
lures.desc: Big flash, big fish. Smaller fish get self-conscious.

lures.name: Woolly Fly
lures.desc: Fussy, floaty, and very good at finding interesting things.

lures.name: Glow Jig
lures.desc: Glows under the surface. Fish find it hard to be cool about it.

lures.name: Golden Lure
lures.desc: Absurd. Ostentatious. The legends cannot resist it.

coolers.name: Little Cooler
coolers.desc: Four fish and one bag of ice. Fits in one hand.

coolers.name: Big Cooler
coolers.desc: Ten fish, two bags of ice. The lid actually closes now.

coolers.name: Sal's Spare Cooler
coolers.desc: Sixteen fish and four bags of ice. Smells faintly of Sal.

smokers.name: One-Hitter
smokers.desc: A brass one-hitter. Discreet, efficient, slightly hot on the lips.

smokers.name: Rolling Papers
smokers.desc: A pack of papers. Faster ceremony, same weed.

smokers.name: Backwoods
smokers.desc: A blunt wrap. Slower burn, so the high lasts longer.

smokers.name: Glass Pipe
smokers.desc: A spoon pipe. Better airflow and better luck.

smokers.name: Beaker Bong
smokers.desc: Water filtration. Smooth, cool and long-lasting.

smokers.name: Heady Bong
smokers.desc: Headier glasswork. Hits harder and looks better doing it.

smokers.name: Dab Rig
smokers.desc: The only thing that can smoke concentrate. Worth it.

smokers.name: Hot Press
smokers.desc: Presses flower into concentrate. Use PRESS here, then smoke it.
